blocks.content:
• PFRDA became statutory in 2013.
• Regulates NPS.
• Based on OASIS report.
• Defined contribution scheme.
• Headquarters in New Delhi.

items: Questions frequently test the year PFRDA became statutory (2013).
Confusing 'defined contribution' with 'defined benefit' is a common trap; NPS is a defined contribution scheme.
The OASIS report is specifically linked to the establishment of the NPS framework.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: PFRDA attained statutory status in the year 2013.
PFRDA is the regulator for the National Pension System (NPS).
The pension framework is based on the recommendations of the OASIS report.
NPS is structured as a defined contribution scheme.
The headquarters of PFRDA is located in New Delhi.
